select
, IF(tfg.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{planInfo.portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order1 , IF(tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1=#{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order2
, IF(tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2=#{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order3
, 99 as order3
, IF(tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY3=#{planInfo.assetClassify3, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order9
, 99 as order9
, IF(tfg.TERM_TYPE=#{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order4
, 99 order4
, IF(tfg.CUSTOMER_ID= #{planInfo.brokerageNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order5
, 99 order5
, IF(tfg.SEC_ACCT_ID= #{planInfo.secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order6
, 99 order6
, IF(tfg.REGIST_ORG=#{planInfo.registOrg, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order7
, 99 order7
, IF(tfg.TRADE_PLAT= #{planInfo.tradePlatform, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 99) order8
, 99 order8
from TRD_FEE_CONFIG tfg /* 交易费用配置 */ where tfg.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{feeDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND tfg.TRADE_MARKET = #{planInfo.tradeMarket, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.FEE_TYPE = #{planInfo.feeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.TRADE_TYPE = #{planInfo.tradeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tfg.PS = #{planInfo.ps, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tfg.TERM_TYPE = #{planInfo.termType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = #{planInfo.assetClassify1, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = '' or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY1 = null)
AND (tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = #{planInfo.assetClassify2, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = '' or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY2 = null)
AND (tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY3 = #{planInfo.assetClassify3, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY3 = '' or tfg.ASSET_CLASSIFY3 = null)
ORDER BY order1, order2, order3, order4, order5, order6, order7, order8, order9, tfg.EFF_DATE
